identity.name: RiverWalk of the Palm Beaches
identity.hoa_name: RiverWalk of the Palm Beaches Homeowners Association, Inc.
identity.notes: Gated waterfront/lakefront community in West Palm Beach, FL (primarily ZIP 33411) with approximately 1,367 DiVosta-built homes (1995-2001), including single-family homes and townhomes with waterfront views. Managed by FirstService Residential (7459 RiverWalk Circle, Suite 315). Resort-style living with three heated pools, eight lighted tennis/pickleball courts, 24/7 fitness center, 12 miles of walking/biking paths and pedestrian bridges, and an on-site Town Center with café, library, post office, salon, and meeting rooms.

fees.note: Quarterly HOA assessment fees (billed Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1); exact amounts vary by home type and are not itemized in public sources. Fees are set annually (budgeting starts mid-August, finalized by the Board in November, effective Jan 1) by dividing Operating expenses plus Contributions to Reserves among the 1,367 units (by home type), then dividing by 4. Capital Contributions are NOT part of quarterly fees. Auto-pay available via ClickPay (Clickpay.com). Contact FirstService Residential for current amounts. Source: official HOA FAQ; corroborated by hoabulletinboard.com. Retrieved 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z (UTC). Confidence: 0.85 (official HOA site for fee structure; amounts unverified).

Capital contribution upon purchase equals one quarterly assessment fee (amount varies by home type). Source: hoabulletinboard.com summary of RiverWalk HOA. Retrieved 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z (UTC). Confidence: 0.65 (reputable aggregator, not official).
